question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The correct answer is '**Desparate**'. ***__Key Points__** __ • Among the given Option the incorrectly spelt word is '**Desparate**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Desperate**'. • It means 'out of control and ready to do anything to change the situation you are in because it is so terrible'. (अत्‍यधिक निराशा के कारण दुस्‍साहसी, निराशोन्‍मत) • *Example: She became **desperate** when her money ran out.* **Correct Answer:__** Desparate.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Separate**: apart; not together. (अलग, पृथक; न जुड़ा हुआ) • **Considerate**: careful not to upset people; always thinking of other people’s wishes and feelings. (दूसरों की भावनाओं या आवश्‍यकताओं का ध्यान रखने वाला; संवेदनशील) • **Disparate**: consisting of people or things that are very different from each other in character or quality. (व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु जो आचरण और गुण में बेहद भिन्‍न हों) 3e:T5d2, The erroneous part is **'has been resuming'.**
